protected_experiments: No writes outside this project to LLMRouter/E4/C9/E2/E3

smoke.algorithm: Unmodified scripts/routerbench.py via run_reproduction.py input adapter

gate: Smoke PASS iff upstream Cascade Routing AUC > Routing AUC and > Cascade baseline AUC. No retuning on failure.

extension.overall_gate: At least 5 of the 9 preselected dataset/pool settings jointly exceed both baselines by upstream AUC

metrics.total_cost: Mean realized cost times held-out sample count; cascades include all calls
metrics.normalized_cost: Mean realized cost divided by maximum held-out single-model mean cost within pool
metrics.auc: Upstream auc_all including its original endpoints and normalization
metrics.static: Single model selected by highest training mean quality; no single-point AUC
metrics.oracle: Mean per-query maximum published quality; cost and AUC undefined

caveats: GroundTruthQualityComputer uses noisy ground truth, not a deployable learned predictor.
GSM8K subset is not directly comparable with full RouterBench paper scores.
Upstream budget grid uses held-out single-model aggregates; retained for fidelity and disclosed.
failure_policy: Repair environment, paths, or data versions only; never algorithms, thresholds, or splits.
data_source_selected: Verified official RouterBench Hugging Face zero-shot pickle, converted to CSV; author archive not used
source_equivalence_limit: Direct RouterBench release verified; byte identity with CSV in authors full archive has not been established.
